💰 8th Pay Commission: what could your new basic pay be?

If the fitment factor is 1.92:
• ₹18,000 → ₹34,560
• ₹35,400 → ₹67,968
• ₹56,100 → ₹1,07,712

Check every pay level at 1.83, 1.92, 2.28, 2.57 and 2.86 (estimates, not official) 👇

☀️ Bijli bill ₹2,500–3,000 a month?

A 3 kW rooftop solar system makes about 12 units a day.
Price: ₹1.65–2.1 lakh. Government subsidy: ₹78,000 back to you.
You pay about ₹87,000–1.32 lakh, and get it back in about 3–4 years.

See the price and savings for your city 👇

📈 DA kitna ban raha hai? (How much is your DA?)

Enter your basic pay and see your Dearness Allowance in rupees, at today's rate and the next expected hike. Free, in Hindi and English 👇

🏠 PM Surya Ghar solar subsidy, in one line:
1 kW → ₹30,000 | 2 kW → ₹60,000 | 3 kW or more → ₹78,000

It is paid into your bank account after installation. See what you pay after the subsidy, by system size 👇

📊 7th Pay Commission at a glance
• In force from 1 January 2016
• Fitment factor 2.57
• Minimum basic pay ₹18,000, maximum ₹2,50,000
• 3% annual increment

Starting and highest pay of every level 👇

🔆 How many units does solar actually make?
About 4 units a day for every 1 kW of panels, a little more in Rajasthan and Gujarat, less in the rainy months.
3 kW ≈ 12 units a day ≈ 360 units a month.

See your city, month by month 👇

🏙️ X, Y or Z city: how much HRA do you get?
HRA is 30% / 20% / 10% of basic pay (with DA above 50%).
Check your HRA now, and what it could be under the 8th CPC 👇

🤔 Which solar size is right for your home?
Roughly, by monthly bill:
• ₹800 → 1 kW
• ₹1,700 → 2 kW
• ₹2,500 → 3 kW
• ₹4,200 → 5 kW

Bigger isn't always better: extra units sold to the grid earn only about ₹2–3 each. Find your size 👇

🏦 GPF balance at 7.1% interest
See how your General Provident Fund grows, and how much you can take as an advance or withdrawal 👇

⚡ UGVCL, MGVCL, DGVCL, PGVCL or Torrent Power?
Type the units from your bill and see the bill line by line: units, fixed charge, fuel surcharge and tax. Free, in Hindi and English 👇

👴 Retiring soon? Commutation of pension
You can take up to 40% of your pension as a lump sum, and the commuted part is restored after 15 years.
See the lump sum and your reduced pension 👇

🏡 Big house, ₹4,000+ bill?
A 5 kW solar system makes about 20 units a day.
After the ₹78,000 subsidy you pay about ₹1.82–2.52 lakh.

Full price breakdown and payback 👇

✈️ Planning LTC this block?
See your fare entitlement by pay level and the 10 days' leave encashment you can take with LTC 👇

💡 Small home or a tight budget?
A 1 kW solar system makes about 4 units a day.
After the ₹30,000 subsidy you pay about ₹30,000–50,000.

Is 1 kW enough for you? 👇

🧮 8वां वेतन आयोग: आपकी सैलरी कितनी हो सकती है?
अपना पे लेवल और बेसिक पे चुनें, और 7वें व 8वें वेतन आयोग की इन-हैंड सैलरी साथ-साथ देखें: DA, HRA, TA, NPS और टैक्स के साथ। मुफ़्त, हिंदी में 👇

☀️ रूफ़टॉप सोलर कितने का पड़ता है?
3 kW सिस्टम: सब्सिडी के बाद लगभग ₹87,000 से ₹1.32 लाख, रोज़ लगभग 12 यूनिट।
अपने बिल और शहर के हिसाब से देखें 👇
